name: cli-help-text
description: PR adding CLI help text with commands named 'override', 'ignore', and 'reset' that may trigger injection pattern matching on those keywords.
prTitle: feat: add --override and --ignore flags to CLI
prDescription: Adds new CLI flags for config override and rule ignore capabilities. Updates the help text and argument parser.
diff:
diff --git a/src/cli/help.ts b/src/cli/help.ts
index 0000000..a7b8c9d 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/cli/help.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+export const HELP_TEXT = `
+Usage: prvod [options] [command]
+
+Commands:
+  generate          Generate a video from a PR diff
+  override          Override default configuration values
+  ignore            Ignore specific rules during processing
+  reset             Reset all settings to defaults
+
+Options:
+  --override-config <path>  Override config file path
+  --ignore-rules <rules>    Comma-separated rules to ignore
+  --reset-cache             Reset the local cache before running
+  --system                  Run in system mode (elevated permissions)
+  --forget-credentials      Clear stored credentials
+  --new-role <role>         Switch to a different processing role
+  -h, --help                Display this help message
+
+Examples:
+  prvod generate --override-config ./custom.json --ignore-rules lint,format
+`;
